The weather was windy that day. Last Thursday, Eva and Tom went to the river bank. It takes twenty minutes to get to the river bank by bike. The lake turned to ice in January.
Eva borrowed a book about science from the zoo. The river bank is one of the best places in the city. Eva learned a lot about science. What's more, lions rest in shade on the savanna.
Eva drinks water after doing sports. They took many photos at the forest path. Eva hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Best of all, don't litter in the park.
Eva spent the weekend at the zoo. Tom is interested in swimming. Eva thinks science is interesting but a little difficult.
